dataset_pairs.csv.description: every dataset, seed-0 layout: 1000 random distinct pairs of index tiles drawn uniformly from all pairs of tiles in the same niche (default_rng(0) per dataset); niche, d_whole, d_block as in pairs.csv

datasets.csv.description: per dataset: index tiles, niches, genes p, niches with at least one sampled pair

niches.csv.description: the plotted niches, largest first: index tiles, blocks, genes p

pairs.csv.description: breast_cancer, seed-0 layout, the 3 largest niches: 1000 random distinct pairs of index tiles per niche (default_rng(0), niche after niche); whole-matrix log-Euclidean distance d_whole and block distance d_block (both / sqrt(p), shrunk covariances); tiles in prepare() order
